notes.title: The free DLC "Proteus" of "Pronty" is officially launched!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are 18Light Game, and we are delighted to see you again in the deep sea.

The new DLC for "Pronty: Proteus"  has officially launched today, and players who have purchased the game can download and play it for free.

Since its launch, "Pronty" has received great reviews both domestically and internationally. The thrilling and challenging boss battles have sparked discussions among hardcore players. Therefore, we have decided to release the "Pronty: Proteus" DLC in the form of "ultra-high difficulty" for fans to showcase their skills.

In the ultra-high difficulty mode, players must survive in a challenging environment until the end of the battle to receive a new reward, the "ES-021" skin. This skin can be applied in the "Pronty" game and players can enjoy a completely different look for the protagonist Pronty in the story.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/0b597549b1538c15081b4951b87ca06b0dcce0a5.png[/img]


Finally, we hope you can find joy and meaning in the ocean. Please give "Pronty" a good review and recommendation, as this will be a source of motivation for us to continue creating. If you would like to share your gaming experience with us, feel free to join the official discussion forum of 18Light Game.

- Discord：https://discord.gg/HEap4TCC7e

Update v3.0.0 includes:

*Added "Proteus"  mode.
*Added the rewarding skin for completing the "Proteus" mode.
*Added German, French, and Arabic language options.
*Optimized the UI.
*Optimized performance.
*Fixed known bugs.

notes.title: "Pronty: Neptune’s Hall" DLC has been officially launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/36a6f8986ea1da5a391a13023adae04337418e67.png[/img]

Hello everyone, we are 18Light Game.
"Pronty: Neptune’s Hall " DLC has been officially launched today, and is now open to players who have purchased the game itself to download and play for free.

In order to thank the majority of players for their love for the battle levels in the game, we decided to launch the "Boss Rush" stage to provide fans with endless skills to learn from, and look forward to players who are brave enough to challenge themselves to pass the level.
"Neptune’s Hall" is a training space designed to continuously strengthen the ability of "Advanced Guardian". The demon kings of each level will take turns in battle. You must defeat them in order and survive to the end. You can clear the level with zero death in the whole battle.

With the release of free DLC, the function of changing the appearance of the protagonist has been added to the game itself. The skin can be applied to the main game "Pronty", and enjoy the protagonist Purdy's completely different appearance in the story.
This new costume is designed with the concept of two very popular Bosses:

[b]- Guardian armor forged inspired by the appearance of "Lamina". [/b] (You can get it after clearing the "Neptune’s Hall" DLC)
[b]- The appearance that was mutated after being cursed by "Hellish Rabbit". [/b] (You can get it by successfully unlocking the hidden ending)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/fa957f52faa29c971e584f830a94541afad81f3c.png[/img]

In addition, the digital soundtrack, Pronty Soundtrack, is available on Steam at the same time as this update.
Composer "Su Yubo", who once compiled the soundtrack for the development team's previous work "Behind the Screen", devoted himself to creating an exclusive and charming soundtrack for each battle and each scene.
A complete collection of 19 game BGMs leads the guardians to taste the purest original sound.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1852900

notes.title: V1.1 Version Update!
notes.content:
V1.1 version accumulation update project

New additions and optimization adjustments:
1. Added V-Sync and FPS adjustment functions.
2. Adjusted the game difficulty slightly.
3. Added fast travel waterslides before Golden Chattertooth and Meduso Magna.
4. Added fast travel waterslides before Lamina.
5. Optimized some route navigation.
6. Optimized gamepad detection.
7. Autosave after repairing or using fast travel waterslides.
8. Optimized some areas performance.

Bug Fixed:
1. Fixed a bug that gamepad will easily snap to the diagonals.
2. Fixed somes of english scripts.
3. Fixed a bug that the countdown sound of gate won't stop.
4. Fixed a bug that the first gate before the refinery will keep respawning.
5. Fixed a bug that won't get the encyclopedia of Silver Chattertooth.
6. Fixed a bug that landmark will lost position after placing.
7. Change the price of outpost and custom landmarks.
8. Fixed a bug where the map in the refinery gate would not be unlocked.
9. Fixed a bug that Time bombs will break one-way shortcuts.
10. Fixed a bug that Toby's encyclopedia information was discovered too early. "
11. Fixed a bug of not getting achievements.
12. Fixed a bug of the abnormal handle operations, such as unable to aim, sprint... etc.
13. Fixed a bug that can not go back to the lower left corner of Waste Processing Plant.
14. Fixed a bug that setting fps to 30 will lag.
15. Fixed a bug that buy the ID card directly will make the game progress block.
16. Fixed a bug that gamepad won't show the control tip.
17. Fixed a bug that the information of map beside MINA was not syncing with map in codex.
